rrc_district_no.description: Item 28 'RRC District No.' for THIS Field Information row (on the Field Information grid; page varies by form revision): the Railroad Commission district number of the field/reservoir of anticipated completion, a short numeric/alphanumeric code (e.g. '08', '7B', '10'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the top-level form-wide 'rrc_district_no' (item 12 on page 1, the district of the SURFACE LOCATION) or with field_no (item 29, the field identifier in this same row).
rrc_district_no.title: RRC District No

field_no.description: Item 29 'Field No.' for THIS Field Information row (on the Field Information grid; page varies by form revision): the RRC-assigned field identification number for the field/reservoir of anticipated completion (typically an 8-digit numeric code). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. This is the row identity key. Do NOT confuse with rrc_district_no (item 28, the 2-3 char district), the drilling_permit_no header field, or field_name (item 30, the textual name).
field_no.title: Field No

field_name.description: Item 30 'Field Name (exactly as shown in RRC records)' for THIS Field Information row (on the Field Information grid; page varies by form revision): the textual field/reservoir name, which may be 'WILDCAT'. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Copy exactly as shown in RRC records. Do NOT confuse with lease_name (item 4 header) or operator_name (item 2 header), and do NOT confuse with field_no (item 29, the numeric code in this same row).
field_name.title: Field Name

well_type.description: Item 31 'Well Type' for THIS Field Information row (on the Field Information grid; page varies by form revision): the type of well for this field/reservoir (e.g. 'OIL', 'GAS', 'INJ'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/etc., separate boolean fields) or with completion_depth (item 32 in this same row).
well_type.title: Well Type

completion_depth.description: Item 32 'Completion Depth' for THIS Field Information row (on the Field Information grid; page varies by form revision): the anticipated completion depth for this field/reservoir, a depth value as printed (digits, may include commas; include the unit only if printed). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with true_vertical_depth (item 10 header, page 1) or with distance_nearest_well (item 33 in this same row).
completion_depth.title: Completion Depth

distance_nearest_well.description: Item 33 'Distance to Nearest Well on this lease in this Reservoir' for THIS Field Information row (on the Field Information grid; page varies by form revision): a distance value as printed (typically in feet). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with distance_to_nearest_lease_line (item 20 header, page 1, distance to the lease LINE not the nearest WELL) or with no_wells_lease_reservoir (item 34, a COUNT not a distance, in this same row).
distance_nearest_well.title: Distance To Nearest Well

no_wells_lease_reservoir.description: Item 34 'No. of Wells on this lease in this Reservoir' for THIS Field Information row (on the Field Information grid; page varies by form revision): the COUNT of wells on this lease in this reservoir, a small integer printed as text. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with distance_nearest_well (item 33, a distance in this same row) or with number_total_acres (item 21 header, page 1).
no_wells_lease_reservoir.title: No Of Wells On This Lease In This Reservoir

api_no.description: Top-left header box on page 1 labeled 'Enter if Assigned: API No.: 42-'. The American Petroleum Institute well number; the form pre-prints the Texas state prefix '42-', so capture the digits the operator enters after '42-' (the county + unique well portion), or the full number if printed. Preserve leading zeros and any hyphens; use null if blank (most blank/new applications leave this empty). Do NOT confuse with drilling_permit_no (the box directly below) or rrc_operator_no (item 1).
api_no.title: API No 42

drilling_permit_no.description: Top-left header box on page 1 labeled 'Drilling Permit No.', directly below the API No. box. The RRC-assigned drilling permit number (assigned by the Commission; 'Enter if Assigned', so usually blank on a new application). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with api_no (box above), rrc_operator_no (item 1), or stacked_lateral_record_well_permit_no (item 9).
drilling_permit_no.title: Drilling Permit No

rrc_operator_no.description: Item 1 'RRC Operator No.' (page 1, first labeled box of the operator block). The Railroad Commission operator number from the operator's P-5 Organization Report (typically a 6-digit code). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with api_no / drilling_permit_no (header boxes above) or with rrc_district_no (item 12).
rrc_operator_no.title: RRC Operator No

operator_name.description: Item 2 'Operator Name (as shown on P-5 Organization Report)' (page 1). The full operator/company name, copied exactly as it appears on the P-5. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with lease_name (item 4), name_of_representative (certificate block, page 2), or field_name (item 30).
operator_name.title: Operator Name As Shown On P 5 Organization Report

operator_address.description: Item 3 'Operator Address (include street, city, state, zip)' (page 1, top-right box). The full single-line mailing address of the operator (street, city, state, ZIP). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Capture the entire address as one string. Do NOT confuse with email_address or telephone (certificate block, page 2).
operator_address.title: Operator Address Include Street City State Zip

lease_name.description: Item 4 'Lease Name' (page 1). The name of the lease on which the well is located. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with operator_name (item 2), well_no (item 5), or field_name (item 30).
lease_name.title: Lease Name

well_no.description: Item 5 'Well No.' (page 1, to the right of Lease Name). The well number/designation on this lease (often alphanumeric, e.g. '1H', '2'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with lease_name (item 4), api_no, or no_wells_lease_reservoir (item 34).
well_no.title: Well No

purpose_new_drill.description: Item 6 'Purpose of Filing (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1 (GENERAL INFORMATION band). True if the 'New Drill' box is checked, false if left blank. More than one box in item 6 may be checked. Do NOT confuse the item 6 purpose checkboxes with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional/Sidetrack). Specifically the 'New Drill' option (a brand-new wellbore). Do NOT confuse with purpose_re_enter or purpose_recompletion.
purpose_new_drill.title: New Drill

purpose_recompletion.description: Item 6 'Purpose of Filing (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1 (GENERAL INFORMATION band). True if the 'Recompletion' box is checked, false if left blank. More than one box in item 6 may be checked. Do NOT confuse the item 6 purpose checkboxes with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional/Sidetrack). Specifically the 'Recompletion' option. Do NOT confuse with purpose_reclass or purpose_new_drill.
purpose_recompletion.title: Recompletion

purpose_reclass.description: Item 6 'Purpose of Filing (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1 (GENERAL INFORMATION band). True if the 'Reclass' box is checked, false if left blank. More than one box in item 6 may be checked. Do NOT confuse the item 6 purpose checkboxes with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional/Sidetrack). Specifically the 'Reclass' (reclassification) option. Do NOT confuse with purpose_recompletion or purpose_field_transfer.
purpose_reclass.title: Reclass

purpose_field_transfer.description: Item 6 'Purpose of Filing (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1 (GENERAL INFORMATION band). True if the 'Field Transfer' box is checked, false if left blank. More than one box in item 6 may be checked. Do NOT confuse the item 6 purpose checkboxes with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional/Sidetrack). Specifically the 'Field Transfer' option. Do NOT confuse with purpose_reclass or purpose_amended.
purpose_field_transfer.title: Field Transfer

purpose_re_enter.description: Item 6 'Purpose of Filing (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1 (GENERAL INFORMATION band). True if the 'Re-enter' box is checked, false if left blank. More than one box in item 6 may be checked. Do NOT confuse the item 6 purpose checkboxes with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional/Sidetrack). Specifically the 'Re-enter' option (re-entering an existing wellbore). Do NOT confuse with purpose_new_drill or purpose_recompletion.
purpose_re_enter.title: Re Enter

purpose_amended.description: Item 6 'Purpose of Filing (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1 (GENERAL INFORMATION band). True if the 'Amended' box is checked, false if left blank. More than one box in item 6 may be checked. Do NOT confuse the item 6 purpose checkboxes with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional/Sidetrack). Specifically the plain 'Amended' option. Do NOT confuse with purpose_amended_as_drilled (the separate 'Amended as Drilled (BHL)' box requiring Form W-1D).
purpose_amended.title: Amended

purpose_amended_as_drilled.description: Item 6 'Purpose of Filing (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1 (GENERAL INFORMATION band). True if the 'Amended as Drilled (BHL) (Include Form W-1D)' box is checked, false if left blank. More than one box in item 6 may be checked. Do NOT confuse the item 6 purpose checkboxes with the item 7 Wellbore Profile checkboxes (Vertical/Horizontal/Directional/Sidetrack). Specifically the 'Amended as Drilled (BHL) (Include Form W-1D)' option (amended bottomhole location). Do NOT confuse with the plain purpose_amended box.
purpose_amended_as_drilled.title: Amended As Drilled BHL Include Form W 1D

profile_vertical.description: Item 7 'Wellbore Profile (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1. True if the 'Vertical' box is checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse the item 7 profile checkboxes with the item 6 Purpose of Filing checkboxes. Specifically the 'Vertical' wellbore option. Do NOT confuse with profile_directional or profile_horizontal.
profile_vertical.title: Vertical

profile_horizontal.description: Item 7 'Wellbore Profile (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1. True if the 'Horizontal (Also File Form W-1H)' box is checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse the item 7 profile checkboxes with the item 6 Purpose of Filing checkboxes. Specifically the 'Horizontal (Also File Form W-1H)' option. Do NOT confuse with profile_directional or profile_sidetrack.
profile_horizontal.title: Horizontal Also File Form W 1H

profile_directional.description: Item 7 'Wellbore Profile (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1. True if the 'Directional (Also File Form W-1D)' box is checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse the item 7 profile checkboxes with the item 6 Purpose of Filing checkboxes. Specifically the 'Directional (Also File Form W-1D)' option. Do NOT confuse with profile_horizontal or profile_vertical.
profile_directional.title: Directional Also File Form W 1D

profile_sidetrack.description: Item 7 'Wellbore Profile (Mark ALL appropriate boxes)' on page 1. True if the 'Sidetrack' box is checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse the item 7 profile checkboxes with the item 6 Purpose of Filing checkboxes. Specifically the 'Sidetrack' option. Do NOT confuse with profile_directional.
profile_sidetrack.title: Sidetrack

true_vertical_depth.description: Item 10 'True Vertical Depth' (page 1). The true vertical depth value as printed (digits, may include commas; include unit only if printed). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with completion_depth (item 32 grid), swr40_upper_tvd / swr40_lower_tvd (SWR 40 severance depths, page 2), or distance fields.
true_vertical_depth.title: True Vertical Depth

rule36_hydrogen_sulfide_yes.description: Item 10: 'Is this well subject to Statewide Rule 36 (hydrogen sulfide area)?' — the 'Yes' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. This question appears on the pre-12/2020 W-1 revisions; do NOT confuse with the paired rule36_hydrogen_sulfide_no. If subject to Rule 36, a Form H-9 / Certificate of Compliance is filed separately.
rule36_hydrogen_sulfide_yes.title: Yes

rule36_hydrogen_sulfide_no.description: Item 10: 'Is this well subject to Statewide Rule 36 (hydrogen sulfide area)?' — the 'No' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. This question appears on the pre-12/2020 W-1 revisions; do NOT confuse with the paired rule36_hydrogen_sulfide_yes. If subject to Rule 36, a Form H-9 / Certificate of Compliance is filed separately.
rule36_hydrogen_sulfide_no.title: No

q11_right_to_develop_minerals_row_yes.description: Item 11 on page 1: 'Do you have the right to develop minerals under any right of way?' — the 'Yes' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse with q11_right_to_develop_minerals_row_no (paired 'No') or with the item 8a/8b Yes/No pairs.
q11_right_to_develop_minerals_row_yes.title: Yes

q11_right_to_develop_minerals_row_no.description: Item 11 on page 1: 'Do you have the right to develop minerals under any right of way?' — the 'No' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse with q11_right_to_develop_minerals_row_yes (paired 'Yes').
q11_right_to_develop_minerals_row_no.title: No

rrc_district_no.description: Item 12 'RRC District No.' (page 1, SURFACE LOCATION AND ACREAGE INFORMATION band). The Railroad Commission district number of the SURFACE LOCATION, a short code (e.g. '08', '7B'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the per-row item 28 'RRC District No.' inside the Field Information grid (completion_fields[].rrc_district_no) or with rrc_operator_no (item 1).
rrc_district_no.title: RRC District No

county.description: Item 13 'County' (page 1). The Texas county in which the surface location lies. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with field_name (item 30) or with well_located_nearest_town (item 15).
county.title: County

surface_land.description: Item 14 'Surface Location' on page 1 — the 'Land' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Exactly one of Land / Bay/Estuary / Inland waterway / Offshore is normally checked. Do NOT confuse with the item 7 Wellbore Profile boxes.
surface_land.title: Land

surface_bay_estuary.description: Item 14 'Surface Location' on page 1 — the 'Bay/Estuary' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Exactly one of Land / Bay/Estuary / Inland waterway / Offshore is normally checked. Do NOT confuse with the item 7 Wellbore Profile boxes.
surface_bay_estuary.title: Bay Estuary

surface_inland_waterway.description: Item 14 'Surface Location' on page 1 — the 'Inland waterway' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Exactly one of Land / Bay/Estuary / Inland waterway / Offshore is normally checked. Do NOT confuse with the item 7 Wellbore Profile boxes.
surface_inland_waterway.title: Inland Waterway

surface_offshore.description: Item 14 'Surface Location' on page 1 — the 'Offshore' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Exactly one of Land / Bay/Estuary / Inland waterway / Offshore is normally checked. Do NOT confuse with the item 7 Wellbore Profile boxes.
surface_offshore.title: Offshore

well_located_miles.description: Item 15 on page 1, first blank of the sentence 'This well is to be located ____ miles in a ____ direction from ____, which is the nearest town in the county.' This field holds the DISTANCE value (number of miles) only. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with well_located_direction (the compass direction blank) or well_located_nearest_town (the town-name blank) in the same sentence; also do NOT confuse with distance_to_nearest_lease_line (item 20).
well_located_miles.title: Miles

well_located_direction.description: Item 15 on page 1, the DIRECTION blank of the sentence ('___ miles in a ___ direction from ___'). Holds the compass direction text (e.g. 'NW', 'South'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with well_located_miles (the mileage) or well_located_nearest_town (the town name) in the same sentence.
well_located_direction.title: Direction

well_located_nearest_town.description: Item 15 on page 1, the TOWN blank of the sentence ('... from ___, which is the nearest town in the county.'). Holds the nearest-town name. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with county (item 13), well_located_direction, or well_located_miles in the same sentence.
well_located_nearest_town.title: Nearest Town In The County

section.description: Item 16 'Section' (page 1). The survey section identifier of the surface location. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with block (item 17), survey (item 18), or abstract_no (item 19).
section.title: Section

block.description: Item 17 'Block' (page 1). The survey block identifier. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with section (item 16), survey (item 18), or abstract_no (item 19).
block.title: Block

survey.description: Item 18 'Survey' (page 1). The survey (abstract survey / grantee survey) name or number. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with section (item 16), block (item 17), abstract_no (item 19), or survey_perp_1/2 (item 24 perpendiculars).
survey.title: Survey

abstract_no.description: Item 19 'Abstract No' (page 1). The land abstract number. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with survey (item 18), section (item 16), or any docket/permit number.
abstract_no.title: Abstract No

distance_to_nearest_lease_line.description: Item 20 'Distance to nearest lease line from surface location' (page 1). A distance value, typically in feet. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with distance_nearest_well (item 33 grid, distance to nearest WELL), the item 23/24 perpendicular 'ft. from the' values, or well_located_miles (item 15).
distance_to_nearest_lease_line.title: Distance To Nearest Lease Line From Surface Location

number_total_acres.description: Item 21 'Number of total acres in lease, pooled unit or unitized tract' (page 1). The total acreage value as printed (may include a decimal). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with no_wells_lease_reservoir (item 34, a well count) or distance fields.
number_total_acres.title: Number Of Total Acres In Lease Pooled Unit Or Unitized Tract

lease_perp_1_ft.description: Item 23 'Lease Perpendiculars' on page 1, the FIRST call. This sentence reads '____ ft. from the ____ line and ____ ft. from the ____ line.' This field is the first distance value (the feet before the first 'ft. from the'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with lease_perp_1_line (the line name of the first call), lease_perp_2_ft (the second call's distance), or the Survey Perpendiculars in item 24.
lease_perp_1_ft.title: Ft From The 1

lease_perp_1_line.description: Item 23 'Lease Perpendiculars' on page 1, the FIRST call's line/direction. The text naming the reference line of the first perpendicular (e.g. 'North', 'East'), filled after 'ft. from the' and before 'line'. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with lease_perp_1_ft (the distance of this call), lease_perp_2_line (second call), or item 24 survey lines.
lease_perp_1_line.title: Line 1

lease_perp_2_ft.description: Item 23 'Lease Perpendiculars' on page 1, the SECOND call's distance (the feet before the second 'ft. from the'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with lease_perp_1_ft (first call), lease_perp_2_line (this call's line name), or item 24 survey perpendiculars.
lease_perp_2_ft.title: Ft From The 2

lease_perp_2_line.description: Item 23 'Lease Perpendiculars' on page 1, the SECOND call's line/direction (after the second 'ft. from the', before the final 'line'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with lease_perp_2_ft (this call's distance), lease_perp_1_line (first call), or item 24 survey lines.
lease_perp_2_line.title: Line 2

survey_perp_1_ft.description: Item 24 'Survey Perpendiculars' on page 1, the FIRST call's distance. Same sentence structure as item 23 ('____ ft. from the ____ line and ____ ft. from the ____ line.'); per the note above item 23, item 24 survey-line calls are used instead of lease-line calls when the answer to 8a is Yes. This field is the first distance value (feet). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with the item 23 LEASE perpendiculars (lease_perp_*), survey_perp_1_line (this call's line), or survey_perp_2_ft (second call).
survey_perp_1_ft.title: Ft From The 1

survey_perp_1_line.description: Item 24 'Survey Perpendiculars' on page 1, the FIRST call's line/direction (after 'ft. from the', before 'line'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with survey_perp_1_ft (this call's distance), survey_perp_2_line (second call), the item 23 lease perpendiculars, or the item 18 'Survey' name.
survey_perp_1_line.title: Line 1

survey_perp_2_ft.description: Item 24 'Survey Perpendiculars' on page 1, the SECOND call's distance (feet before the second 'ft. from the'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with survey_perp_1_ft (first call), survey_perp_2_line (this call's line), or the item 23 lease perpendiculars.
survey_perp_2_ft.title: Ft From The 2

survey_perp_2_line.description: Item 24 'Survey Perpendiculars' on page 1, the SECOND call's line/direction (after the second 'ft. from the', before the final 'line'). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with survey_perp_2_ft (this call's distance), survey_perp_1_line (first call), or the item 23 lease perpendiculars.
survey_perp_2_line.title: Line 2

q25_pooled_unit_yes.description: Item 25 on page 2: 'Is this a pooled unit?' — the 'Yes' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse with q25_pooled_unit_no (paired 'No') or with the item 27 substandard-acreage Yes/No pair.
q25_pooled_unit_yes.title: Yes

q25_pooled_unit_no.description: Item 25 on page 2: 'Is this a pooled unit?' — the 'No' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse with q25_pooled_unit_yes (paired 'Yes').
q25_pooled_unit_no.title: No

unitization_docket_no.description: Item 26 'Unitization Docket No' (page 2). The RRC unitization docket number, if any. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with swr_exception_case_docket_no (item 35), swr37_bw_entity_density_docket, or swr40_double_assign_docket_no.
unitization_docket_no.title: Unitization Docket No

q27_substandard_acreage_yes.description: Item 27 on page 2: 'Are you applying for Substandard Acreage?' — the 'Yes (attach Form W-1A)' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse with q27_substandard_acreage_no (paired 'No') or with the item 25 pooled-unit Yes/No pair.
q27_substandard_acreage_yes.title: Yes Attach Form W 1A

q27_substandard_acreage_no.description: Item 27 on page 2: 'Are you applying for Substandard Acreage?' — the 'No' checkbox. True if checked, false if blank. Do NOT confuse with q27_substandard_acreage_yes (paired 'Yes (attach Form W-1A)').
q27_substandard_acreage_no.title: No

swr_exception_case_docket_no.description: Item 35 'Requests for SWR Exceptions' on page 2: the 'If available SWR Exception Case/Docket No.:' text field at the top-right of the SWR section. A case/docket number. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with swr37_bw_entity_density_docket (the SWR 37 between-well 'Entity For Density Docket #'), unitization_docket_no (item 26), or swr40_double_assign_docket_no.
swr_exception_case_docket_no.title: Requests For SWR Exceptions SWR Exception Case Docket No

remarks.description: 'Remarks' free-text box on page 2 (in the certificate band, beside the CERTIFICATE statement). Capture the full multi-line remarks text as one string. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with name_of_representative or the SWR notes.
remarks.title: Remarks

name_of_representative.description: Certificate block on page 2: 'Name of Representative (Print)' — the printed (typed) name of the authorized representative who certifies the application. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with signature_present (the adjacent signature), operator_name (item 2), or email_address.
name_of_representative.title: Name Of Representative Print

signature_present.description: Certificate block on page 2: the 'Signature' field. Model as a boolean presence flag: true if a handwritten/electronic signature or mark is present in the Signature box, false if the box is empty. Do NOT transcribe the signature text. Do NOT confuse with name_of_representative (the printed name to the left) or certificate_date.
signature_present.title: Signature

certificate_date.description: Certificate block on page 2: 'Date (mm/dd/yy)' — the date the representative signed, in mm/dd/yy form. Capture exactly as printed (preserve the printed digits/format, do not normalize). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with any TVD/depth value or with telephone/email.
certificate_date.title: Date Mm Dd Yy

telephone.description: Certificate block on page 2: 'Telephone (AC and number)' — the representative's phone number including area code, exactly as printed (preserve dashes/parentheses/spaces). Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with email_address or with any docket/permit number.
telephone.title: Telephone AC And Number

email_address.description: Certificate block on page 2: 'E-mail Address (OPTIONAL - If provided, e-mail address will become part of this public record.)'. The representative's e-mail address. Extract verbatim exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros, casing and any units. Use null if the cell is blank. Do NOT confuse with telephone, operator_address (item 3), or name_of_representative.
email_address.title: E Mail Address OPTIONAL

completion_fields.description: Item 28-34 'FIELD INFORMATION' grid on page 2 ('List all fields of anticipated completion including Wildcat. List one zone per line.'). Each row of the grid becomes one CompletionField object with cells: rrc_district_no (28), field_no (29), field_name (30), well_type (31), completion_depth (32), distance_nearest_well (33), no_wells_lease_reservoir (34). The blank form pre-prints 3 (here shown as up to several) empty rows; emit ONE object per FILLED row, top-to-bottom, and use null/empty array when the grid is blank. Overflow rows would live on a separate 'Form W-1 Field Information Addendum'. Do NOT confuse this per-row item 28 district with the form-wide item 12 rrc_district_no (surface location, page 1).
